{{Short description|Chinese physicist}}
{{Family name hatnote|[[Zhu (surname)|Zhu]]|lang=Chinese}}
'''Zhu Bangfen''' is a Chinese physicist and professor at [[Tsinghua University]]. He was the Editor-in-Chief of [[Chinese Physics Letters]].<ref name="Order">{{cite web | last=Order | first=Alphabetic | title=ZHU Bangfen-Department of Physics | website=清华大学物理系 | url=https://www.phys.tsinghua.edu.cn/phyen/info/1067/1334.htm | language=zh | access-date=2022-12-28}}</ref>

==Education and career==

He obtained a degree in [[applied physics]] from Tsinghua University in 1970 and a master's degree in [[solid-state physics]] from the same university in 1981. Between 1971 and 1978, he served as a technician at [[Jiangxi Copper]], [[China]]. Between 1981 and 1987, he was an assistant professor at the Institute of Semiconductors, Chinese Academy of Sciences, where he later became a full professor between 1999 and 2000.<ref name="Order"/>

In 2003, he was elected a fellow of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]], and in 2012, he became a fellow of the [[Institute of Physics]].<ref name="Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences">{{cite web | title=Division of Mathematics and Physics---Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | website=Academic Divisions of the Chinese Academy of Sciences | url=http://english.casad.cas.cn/history/Me/Di/Me/Me_DMP/ | language=zh | access-date=2022-12-28 | archive-date=2022-12-27 | archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20221227100643/http://english.casad.cas.cn/history/Me/Di/Me/Me_DMP/ | url-status=dead }}</ref><ref name="Introduction">{{cite web | title=The Department of Physics at Southern University of Science and Technology | website=Introduction | url=https://phy.sustech.edu.cn/about/committee.html?lang=en-us | access-date=2022-12-28}}</ref>
